mapper.insert: insert into participation ( project_id, member_id, want_position, motive, experience, project_role, join_status, applied_at ) values ( #{projectId}, #{memberId}, #{wantPosition}, #{motive}, #{experience}, 'MEMBER', 'WAITING', NOW() )
mapper.select: select p.*, m.name as member_name from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id where p.project_id = #{projectId} and p.project_role = 'MEMBER' order by p.applied_at DESC

select p.*, pr.title, pr.category from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id join project pr on p.project_id = pr.project_id where p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.join_status = 'JOINED' order by p.applied_at DESC limit #{limit}

select p.*, pr.title, pr.category from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id join project pr on p.project_id = pr.project_id where p.member_id = #{memberId} and (p.join_status = 'WAITING' or p.join_status = 'INTERVIEW' or p.join_status = 'REJECTED') order by p.applied_at DESC limit #{limit}
